title: Meta云业务对标亚马逊谷歌卖算力能赚多少？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Mindy, let's start with what meta is doing. What exactly are they doing with this cloud business?
segments.zh: 明迪，先说说Meta在做什么。他们的云业务具体是什么？

segments.en: Well, they were under pressure with that $150 billion of capex spend to show ROI.
segments.zh: 他们面临1500亿美元资本支出的压力，需要展示**回报。

segments.en: And we know they don't have a frontier model like anthropic and open AI.
segments.zh: 而且他们没有像Anthropic和OpenAI那样的前沿模型。

segments.en: And they will talk about agentic AI being that product, but looks like they have pivoted towards selling compute.
segments.zh: 他们会把智能体AI作为产品来谈，但似乎已转向出售算力。

segments.en: Like SpaceX did right before their IPO. And it is a very lucrative business right now.
segments.zh: 就像SpaceX在IPO前所做的那样，现在这业务利润丰厚。

segments.en: Given the supply constraints, I mean, SpaceX signed those two deals with anthropic and Google for almost a $25 billion run rate
segments.zh: 考虑到供应限制，SpaceX与Anthropic和Google签了约250亿美元年化收入的协议，对应1吉瓦容量。

segments.en: for one gigawatt capacity. So if you apply that type of math, then we could be talking about up to $15 to $20 billion
segments.zh: 按此推算，Meta每吉瓦容量可能带来150至200亿美元的增量收入。

segments.en: in incremental revenue per gigawatt that meta has. When you see that, then, do you view that as a pivot away from their AI ambitions or something that can fund their AI ambitions?
segments.zh: 那么，你认为这是偏离AI雄心，还是能为AI雄心提供资金？

segments.en: It could fund, but I view it as a slight negative in the sense, this field is getting very crowded now.
segments.zh: 可以提供资金，但我认为略偏负面，因为算力租赁领域现在非常拥挤。

segments.en: The field of renting compute. And the frontier models, yes, open AI and anthropic are the ones that are actually monetizing
segments.zh: 算力租赁领域，前沿模型如OpenAI和Anthropic才是真正实现商业化的。

segments.en: at the model layer to an extent Google as well.
segments.zh: 在模型层，某种程度上谷歌也是如此。

segments.en: But everyone else is selling raw compute to these companies.
segments.zh: 但其他公司都在向这些企业出售原始算力。

segments.en: So I'm guessing the users of meta compute would likely be anthropic who would say, OK, I'll take your capacity.
segments.zh: 所以我猜Meta算力的用户可能是Anthropic，他们会说，好的，我接受你的容量。

segments.en: I'll monetize it through my model layer.
segments.zh: 我会通过我的模型层将其变现。
